conversationId.description: Unique UUID of the active agent conversation.

workspacePaths.description: Absolute directory paths of the user's mounted workspaces; may be empty for a conversation without a workspace.

transcriptPath.description: Path to the conversation's transcript.jsonl under <app_data_dir>/brain/<conversationId>/.system_generated/logs/.

artifactDirectoryPath.description: Path to the directory containing the conversation's artifacts and screenshots.

modelName.description: Name or identifier of the model handling the invocation; optional because earlier builds did not document or send it.

invocationNum.description: 0-indexed sequence number of the current model invocation; the first invocation is 0.

initialNumSteps.description: Number of steps currently in the trajectory.
